title: Seclusion
hook: After they met, Rumi closed his door. His students waited outside for weeks.

segments.fa: من غلام قمرم، غیر قمر هیچ مگو
segments.en: I am the moon's servant. Speak of nothing but the moon.

segments.fa: پیش من جز سخن شمع و شکر هیچ مگو
segments.en: Before me, speak only of candles and of sugar.

segments.fa: سخن رنج مگو، جز سخن گنج مگو
segments.en: Do not speak of sorrow. Speak only of treasure.

tafsir: The old biographers say Rumi and Shams sat together in seclusion for weeks, some say months.
Rumi stopped teaching. His students lost their master.
And they blamed the stranger from Tabriz.
In this ghazal, the moon is the beloved, and the candle and sugar are his light and sweetness.
Rumi is saying: talk to me only of what I love.
To his students, that sounded like he had left them. To him, it was coming home.

outro.say: Part five. Why did Shams leave Konya? Follow The Guest House.
